answer: A fresh sockpuppet must post the same bond, so faking a crowd is costly. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond before acting, and reputation accrues like a pearl layered over seasons of legitimate work. Detectors also trace each agent's wander path across epochs; clones repeating one route get flagged. Honest actors drift like a river, never looping. Bond forfeiture makes mass identity forgery economically irrational. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
